transcript_raw:
Participant: P01 | Session 2 | Cyberpunk 2077 | full HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 2.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:16] P01: ahh, uhm I kept looking at the waypoint marker and drove toward it.
[00:40] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:48] P01: like, ahh, at first there was too much stuff on the screen at once.
[01:04] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:12] P01: ahh, uh, [silence 8s] my eyes you know, kept going to the minimap corner instead of the road.
[01:30] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[01:35] P01: you know, like, [silence 5s] the marker got confusing uhm when I was inside a building.
[01:54] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:00] P01: uhm ahh, [silence 5s] honestly time went by fast.
[02:37] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[02:44] P01: uh, like, [silence 3s] no, I like, never really had to stop, the map told me everything.
[02:59] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:05] P01: uh, ahh, nothing was uhm missing, if anything there was too much.
[03:38] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[03:43] P01: uh, ahh, [silence 6s] I would make the HUD smaller and remove some of the notifications. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
[04:12] Interviewer: Q9. Was there a moment in either session where you felt completely absorbed? What was on screen?
[04:20] P01: uhm you know, during the fight, I forgot uhm about everything else. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
[04:42] Interviewer: Q10. Comparing both sessions, which HUD setup gave you the better experience exploring, and why?
[04:48] P01: uh, you know, [silence 4s] the minimal ahh, one felt better for exploring even if I got lost.
[05:19] Interviewer: Q11. In which session was it easier to understand what was happening and what to do next?
[05:26] P01: uhm you know, [silence 8s] the full HUD uhm was easier to understand what to do next.
[05:53] Interviewer: Q12. If you could design your own HUD, which elements would you keep and which would you remove?
[05:58] P01: you know, uhm I would keep health and a compass and remove the notifications.
